text:
assetbot: nightly-link-audit flagged ~7 docs images using pre-signed S3 URLs (examples include `?X-Amz-Algorithm=` query params). these render fine initially but expire and cause broken thumbnails in older blog posts. report: https://internal-reports.company/scans/1764999999.csv

nina: thanks for the ping. i maintain the blog/runtime examples. can someone paste a sample URL? i can't access the csv (403).

leo: sample pasted: `https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-docs/media/runtime/diagram.png?X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=...&X-Amz-Expires=3600` — once the token expires the CDN returns 403 and some clients show broken img placeholder. saw this crop up in older migration PRs where copy-paste kept the presigned URL.

carmen: oof. we shouldn't have presigned URLs in source. options: (1) rehost images under our CDN canonical path and update docs, (2) add a build-step that strips query params and rewrites to canonical media path if the file exists, (3) ops add a cache rule that ignores query strings for those object prefixes. prefer (1) + short-term (2) for safety.

nina: i'm happy to own the content fix. quick proposed steps: run a scan to find markdown/image links with `\?X-Amz-` and open a PR replacing with `/media/...` canonical paths (we have the canonical asset manifest). also add a docs-lint rule to fail CI on `\?X-Amz-` in markdown.

leo: quick ripgrep i used: ```rg -n "\?X-Amz-" docs | sed -n '1,200p'``` and a small node script to map presigned URLs to fingerprinted CDN paths using the asset manifest at `scripts/asset-manifest.json`. i'll paste gist after lunch.

ops-runner: note: if you want a server-side fallback we can add an edge rule to normalize query strings for `/media/` prefix but that needs an ops ticket and RFC (we prefer source fixes). ops:OPS-2021 created if you want to track.

carmen: nina can you open two PRs: (A) lint rule only (to stop new presigned URLs from entering), (B) content PR replacing the 7 found links. include a QA checklist: preview in staging, verify images load after token expiry (simulate by removing query in staging), and run `site:build` to ensure manifest mapping.

nina: PRs opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3033 (lint) and https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3034 (content fixes). assigned @carmen for a quick review and added the staging QA steps. cc @leo for the asset mapping note.

leo: left a small comment on 3034 to keep human-readable captions when we rewrite filenames. also pasted gist with mapping helper: https://gist.github.com/leo-map/ef12ab34

ops-runner: ops acked OPS-2021. if content PRs land we will hold off on edge rules. please ping ops if you need a temporary redirect during rollout.

carmen: thanks all. nina when lint PR is green we merge, then content PR. we'll close the scan alert once the staging verification passes. :white_check_mark:
